extraction_notes: The supplied datasheet covers the BC817-40 selection; the requested ordering MPN is BC817-40,215 in SOT23/TO-236AB.

The BC817-40 electrical table publishes hFE = 250 minimum and 600 maximum at IC = 100 mA, plus hFE = 40 minimum at IC = 500 mA; these guaranteed bounds are preserved and are not converted into typical values.
The Fig. 12, Fig. 13, and Fig. 14 25 degC typical curves were manually digitized at sparse points. The plotted VBE(sat) and VCE(sat) curves use IC/IB = 10.
The Fig. 15 output-characteristics curve was sampled for the IB = 6.0 mA trace at three VCE values; it is typical data at Tamb = 25 degC.
No tabulated VBE(on), VBE(sat), or input-capacitance Cibo row is published. VBE(sat) is represented by the digitized Fig. 13 curve, and the 500 mA table saturation point therefore has vbe_sat = null.
The fT entry is a guaranteed minimum and the collector capacitance Cc entry is typical; source kinds are preserved rather than converted into typical estimates.
extraction.omission_reason: Cibo and tabulated VBE(on) are absent from the supplied datasheet. The output curve is only sparsely sampled, and all digitized curve values are approximate typical readings; no additional precision is implied.
